verdict.rationale: The docs describe guardrails as a first-class, optional runtime feature on agents that checks and validates both user input and agent output, and guardrail events are captured in built-in tracing. That covers the core of attaching input/output guardrails, but the evidence is a single thin docs sentence. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of blocking/halting a run on unsafe content (e.g. a tripwire mechanism), evidence of transforming content, detail on how guardrails are attached, independent or hands-on corroboration.
